data.name: Tikam
data.gender_notes: Tikam is used as a masculine name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tikam is recorded with the meaning “Victorious”. Tikam is a Hindu name meaning “Victorious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tikam expresses “Victorious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: Tikam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tikam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is victorious and triumphant in battles

in_hindi.name: Tikam
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tikam एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is victorious and triumphant in battles

in_tamil.name: Tikam
in_tamil.long_meaning: Tikam ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is victorious and triumphant in battles

in_telugu.name: Tikam
in_telugu.long_meaning: Tikam ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is victorious and triumphant in battles

in_marathi.name: Tikam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tikam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is victorious and triumphant in battles

in_bengali.name: Tikam
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tikam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is victorious and triumphant in battles
